tex_content.html: \begin{exercise} \end{exercise} 1. ch8:8-30Suppose $M \subseteq \mathbb {R}^{n+1}$ is a hypersurface with the induced Riemannian metric. Show that the Ricci tensor of $M$ satisfies \[ Rc(v,w) = \langle nHsv - s^2v, w\rangle , \] where $H$ and $s$ are the mean curvature and shape operator of $M$, respectively, and $s^2v = s(sv)$. \end{exercise}
